_shipComment: auto since 2026-11-02 on Corey's word in chat ("Please auto ship things ready"), after the CL5-1 smoke pass
proved build -> review -> merge end to end. Was review-only until then. Migrations and console-control
cards still stop (shipStops below), and auth/sign-in paths are held by ~/dev-loop/auth-gates.json.
deployNote: There is NO hosted deployment: no Vercel, no preview, no production URL. The app runs on the show machine,
which pulls main. So for this repo a ship is: merge at the approved exact head, confirm the merge commit is
on origin/main and the required `verify` check is green on it, then move the card to Done. Do not wait for
or search for a deploy; there is none to find, and the post-condition reads it as unverified, not failed.

shipStops.pathsReason: SQLite schema changes run on the show machine at startup; a bad migration can lock performers out mid-show.
shipStops.labelsReason: console-control no longer stops a merge: Corey ruled 2026-11-03 ("1", CL5-5) that console cards merge after review against the fake console, and the real-console check is CL5-8, which must pass before the first show. Restore it when CL5-8 is Done.
shipStops.riskWordingExemptReason: Corey's standing decision in chat, 2026-11-03: "For CL5 ship anything ready. Even red". The app is not on the show machine and no show uses it yet, so a reviewer-approved PR at its exact head ships without waiting for him, RED included. Observed failure: CL5-4 (#12) was approved at db7464e and sat in My Turn on a needs=red-ship ticket the decision had already answered. Still stops (dev-loop enforces it): review and required checks, needs-human-review, builder escalations, money-path, a person's risk-red, permanent data deletion in the diff, and migrations (they clear only through the exact-head-ci receipt: additive SQL, green verify, receiptTest).
shipStops.riskWordingExemptExpires: ENDS when CL5-8 (the real-CL5 check) is Done and the app is used at its first show. From then a bad merge reaches a live show: delete riskWordingExempt, benchAskExempt and redShipTicketExempt with their Reason/Expires keys, and put console-control back in shipStops.labels.
